_doc: One config for the control mod: paths, price table, metric targets, hidden-rule catalogue, evidence links and every UI label. Nothing names a rules version: the version, sections and rule lines are read live from ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md at each scan. Your own overrides go in paths.user_config (deep-merged, lists replaced); the <...> paths are placeholders, a missing path is skipped.

prices._doc: USD per million tokens. Input/output from docs/models/models.json (claude.com/pricing, 2 Oct). Cache read = 0.1 x input, cache write = 1.25 x input (5-min cache). Haiku 5.5 has no price in models.json: Haiku 4.5's rate is used (estimate).

known_items.ask_filter.py: PreToolUse hook on AskUserQuestion: blocks questions about merges, PRs, CI, branches, reviews, versions, tests, workflows (exit 2); product/scope questions pass.
known_items.watch.py: Free watcher script: OFF since 4 Oct (all ClaudeControl* tasks disabled); nothing writes watch_report, brief.md, quota.jsonl.
known_items.cc-control: Guards (send cap, previews, other sessions, chip cap, build slot), status band, /cc-status /cc-tree /cc-graph.
known_items.hook: Visible rules: no hook, mod or script blocks or rewrites a tool call; active hooks must be none

rules._doc: How the live rules file is read. version_regex finds the version in the first non-empty line (e.g. "Claude Control V5.8 (15 Oct 2026)" -> 5.8); section_regex marks a section heading; a parenthesised part of a line is evidence when it matches citation_regex; practices_ref_regex ids are looked up in paths.practices_md.

evidence_links.find: session that opened the PR merges it

secrets._doc: settings.json env values are shown only for these names, and never for a name matching name_regex. Everything else is listed by name only.

v6._doc: Pending rule changes: git show <ref>:<path> in the rules repo, first ref that has the file. Headings or table cells with one of the group words sort the bullets under them.

config_claude._doc: CONFIG view (/config-claude, /control config): what it reads, the built-in agents and documented defaults it shows, and its labels. Secrets: a settings value whose key matches secret_regex, any env value whose name starts with env_names_only_prefixes, and token-looking strings are masked before anything is written. Doc facts read on code.claude.com on 16 Oct 2026; verified=false marks what the docs do not say.
